g.text: Kafka ingestion: happy path, business rejection, poison pill, transient failure
poll() record (key = tradeId, value read as String)
[empty, over kafka.max-message-bytes (US-607.1), not JSON, or wrong JSON types (POISON: US-302)]
publish key + value (oversized: truncated, header trade-store-dlt-truncated),
partition by key, + headers (topic, partition, offset, exception class/message)
A MongoDB failure here is logged at ERROR
and counted, not thrown: the DLT record is the durable
log tradeId, version, outcome, channel (no payload)
Not rethrown: never retried or dead-lettered.
[until the database is back, exponential backoff (partition waits)]
offset NOT committed; record is redelivered later
